mapper.select: SELECT sys99_string02 AS cur_code , sys99_string04 AS class_name , sys99_string01 AS account_name , sys99_double01 AS pre_day_amt , sys99_double02 AS hold_qty , SUM(CAST(sys99_double10 AS FLOAT)) AS in_amt , SUM(CAST(sys99_double20 AS FLOAT)) AS out_amt FROM sys99_print WHERE sys99_group_id = #{groupId} AND sys99_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_string01, sys99_double01, sys99_double02, sys99_string05, sys99_long10, sys99_long11 ORDER BY sys99_string05, sys99_long10, sys99_long11

SELECT ast06_tr_id AS tr_id , ast06_date AS date , ast06_amt AS amt , ast06_note AS note , ( SELECT f_get_account_nm(act13_company_id, act13_real_account_cd) FROM act13_real_account_map WHERE act13_company_id = ast06_company_id AND act13_repr_account_cd = '5804' /*(5804:복리후생비계정)*/ AND act13_account_map LIKE '953003%' /*(953003:사대보험)*/ LIMIT 1 ) AS insure_account_name , ast21_np_etc_note AS np_etc_note , ast21_hi_etc_note AS hi_etc_note , ast21_ei_etc_note AS ei_etc_note , ast21_oh_etc_note AS oh_etc_note FROM ast06_tr LEFT OUTER JOIN ast21_tr_4insure ON ast21_tr_id = ast06_tr_id WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast06_tr_id = #{trId}

WITH tr AS ( SELECT * , TO_CHAR((ast06_date + INTERVAL '-1month')::date, 'YYYY월 MM월') AS notice_month FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN ast21_tr_4insure ON ast21_tr_id = ast06_tr_id WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast06_date = #{trDate} ) , cnt AS ( SELECT pay11_item_cd , count(*) ast21_emp_cnt FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT pay11_item_cd, pay10_person_id FROM pay10_month INNER JOIN pay11_month_item ON pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id WHERE pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_std_month = TO_CHAR((#{trDate}::date + INTERVAL '-1month')::date,'YYYY.MM') AND pay11_item_amt != 0 AND pay11_item_cd IN ('210','220','240') ) t GROUP BY pay11_item_cd ) SELECT type_nm AS type_name, notice_month, emp_cnt, company_amt, emp_amt, pay_amt, etc_amt, real_pay_amt FROM ( SELECT '210' AS type_cd , '국민연금' AS type_nm , notice_month AS notice_month , (SELECT ast21_emp_cnt FROM cnt WHERE pay11_item_cd = '210') AS emp_cnt , COALESCE(ast21_np_company,0) AS company_amt , COALESCE(ast21_np_withholding,0) AS emp_amt , COALESCE(ast21_np_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_np_withholding,0) AS pay_amt , COALESCE(ast21_np_etc,0) AS etc_amt , COALESCE(ast21_np_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_np_withholding,0) + COALESCE(ast21_np_etc,0) AS real_pay_amt FROM tr UNION ALL SELECT '220' , '국민건강' , notice_month , (SELECT ast21_emp_cnt FROM cnt WHERE pay11_item_cd = '220') , COALESCE(ast21_hi_company,0) , COALESCE(ast21_hi_withholding,0) , COALESCE(ast21_hi_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_hi_withholding,0) , COALESCE(ast21_hi_etc,0) , COALESCE(ast21_hi_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_hi_withholding,0) + COALESCE(ast21_hi_etc,0) FROM tr UNION ALL SELECT '240' , '고용보험' , notice_month , (SELECT ast21_emp_cnt FROM cnt WHERE pay11_item_cd = '240') , COALESCE(ast21_ei_company,0) , COALESCE(ast21_ei_withholding,0) , COALESCE(ast21_ei_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_ei_withholding,0) , COALESCE(ast21_ei_etc,0) , COALESCE(ast21_ei_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_ei_withholding,0) + COALESCE(ast21_ei_etc,0) FROM tr UNION ALL SELECT '900' , '산재보험' , notice_month , (SELECT ast21_emp_cnt FROM cnt WHERE pay11_item_cd = '240') , COALESCE(ast21_oh_company,0) , 0 , COALESCE(ast21_oh_company,0) , COALESCE(ast21_oh_etc,0) , COALESCE(ast21_oh_company,0) + COALESCE(ast21_oh_etc,0) FROM tr ) u ORDER BY type_cd

SELECT f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, f_sysdate()) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = #{personId} AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = #{personId} AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) LIMIT 1
